unknownRule: This check could not be completed with the available data.
violationSummary: The documented information conflicts with the checked rule.
missingSummary: Unambiguous information is missing for this check.
violationAction: Review and correct the service and its documentation, then check again.
missingAction: Complete missing or conflicting information in the FHIR treatment plan, then check again.
implantAction: Document the implant system from the treatment records and link the evidence to GOZ 9040, then check again.
supportAction: Document whether the abutment is a natural tooth or an implant, then check again.
justificationSummary: The individual written justification for the increased factor is missing or not sufficiently confirmed.
justificationAction: Document the individual difficulty and save the service justification. Free text cannot replace missing clinical confirmation.
companionSummary: The documented abutment or implant system does not meet this service requirement.
quantitySummary: The billed quantity does not match the number of uniquely identified treatment units.
includedSummary: According to the documented relationship, this action is already included in another service.
impressionSummary: The impression required for this provisional restoration is explicitly recorded as absent.
technicalSummary: This check is unavailable technically or for the requested assessment date.
technicalAction: Have the rule sources and technical details checked. This does not establish a billing violation.
copyAccount: The source plan must have one unambiguous cost plan Account.
invalidAccount: The source Account reference is invalid.
foreignAccount: The source Account does not belong to this patient.
copyCoverage: The source Account must have one unambiguous Coverage.
chargesSaveError: {{name}} was saved, but its cost plan was not: {{detail}}
chosenDeleteError: {{name}} is the chosen alternative and cannot be deleted.
noVersion: Treatment plan {{id}} has no version identifier; safe deletion is not possible.
rule.goz-5010-supportKind: In this check, GOZ 5010 requires a natural abutment tooth and cannot be billed on an implant.
rule.goz-9040-implantSystem: GOZ 9040 requires a two-phase implant system. The check remains open without this information.
rule.GOZ-G01: The fee factor is checked against the fee range and, where applicable, a documented individual fee agreement.
rule.GOZ-G02: A factor above 2.3 requires individual justification; documented fee agreements are considered separately.
rule.GOZ-G03: The fee is calculated from the points, point value and factor, rounded to cents.
rule.GOZ-G04: The check requires own-service assignment, documented service content and clinical indication.
rule.GOZ-0030-content: The findings and written treatment and cost plan must be documented.
rule.GOZ-0030-exclusion: GOZ 0030 and 0040 are checked for exclusion for the same planning object.
rule.GOZ-0090-repeat: Repeated anaesthesia for the same target in the same session requires individual justification.
rule.GOZ-2200-exclusion: Filling and crown services are checked for exclusions in the same restoration context.
rule.GOZ-2200-included: Component services already included in the crown must not be billed separately again.
rule.GOZ-5000-included: Component services already included in the bridge abutment are checked for duplicate billing.
rule.GOZ-5010-included: Component services already included in the bridge abutment are checked for duplicate billing.
rule.GOZ-9010-included: Component services already included in the implantation are checked for duplicate billing.
rule.GOZ-2200-units: The crown quantity must match the uniquely identified teeth or implants.
rule.GOZ-anchor-units: Bridge abutments are counted using uniquely identified abutment units.
rule.GOZ-5070-units: Bridge spans or free-end saddles must be uniquely identified and match the billed quantity.
rule.GOZ-5120-units: The provisional quantity must match the identified teeth or implants.
rule.GOZ-5140-units: The quantity must match the identified provisional spans or free-end saddles.
rule.GOZ-jaw-units: The analysis and template service must be assigned to the respective jaw.
rule.GOZ-9010-units: The implantation quantity must match the uniquely identified implants.
rule.GOZ-provisional: Manufacture, impression and provisional identity are checked; reinsertion or removal may already be included.
rule.GOZ-9000-content: The implant analysis and its required content must be documented.
rule.GOZ-9003-content: Use of the orientation template must be documented.
rule.GOZ-9040-content: Exposure and insertion of abutment elements must be part of the documented service content.
rule.GOZ-9050-context: GOZ 9050 is checked for frequency and exclusions per implant, session and reconstructive phase.
